title: Lok Sabha winning MPs average declared assets
definition: Mean total movable and immovable assets declared by winning Lok Sabha candidates (including spouse and dependents) in sworn Election Commission of India nomination affidavits, as compiled by ADR.

sources.publisher: Association for Democratic Reforms (ADR) and National Election Watch
sources.title: Lok Sabha Elections 2024: Analysis of Criminal Background, Financial, Education, Gender and Other Details of Winning Candidates
Lok Sabha will now have over 500 crorepatis, up from 88% in 2019

points.evidence: This time, the average assets of winners are Rs 46.3 crore, compared to Rs 14.7 crore in 2014.
Average assets: The average of assets per winning candidate in the Lok Sabha Elections 2024 is Rs 46.34 Crore (504 of 543 winners, or 93%, are crorepatis).
